boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named downtown Appleton destinations on the College Avenue corridor beside Lawrence University, each with a current Lawrence-listed student offer.

cards.title: ACOCA
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 500 W. College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk the College Avenue corridor to ACOCA and present a valid LU ID if making a purchase to use the listed cookie offer.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffee stop with a Lawrence-listed cookie offer.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists ACOCA at 500 W. College Avenue and a free cookie offer with any purchase for valid-ID holders.
cards.access_notes: Listed offer requires a valid Lawrence ID and a purchase.

cards.title: Amberlulu Bubble Tea
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 823 W. College Avenue, Suite B
cards.notes: Use this westward College Avenue stop for bubble tea; bring a valid LU ID if you want to ask about the listed student discount.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue bubble-tea destination with a listed ID discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Amberlulu Bubble Tea at 823 W. College Avenue, Suite B, with a 15% discount and free delivery offer.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer is for Lawrence students, faculty, and staff with valid ID.

cards.title: Blue Moon Emporium
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 227 E. College Avenue
cards.notes: Browse the shop along College Avenue and show a valid LU ID at checkout if purchasing in-stock merchandise under the listed offer.
cards.short_summary: A retail stop with a documented Lawrence community discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Blue Moon Emporium at 227 E. College Avenue and a 10% discount on in-stock merchandise.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer is for Lawrence students, faculty, and staff with valid ID.

cards.title: Brewed Awakenings
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 107 E. College Avenue
cards.notes: Make this College Avenue café a quick stop and show a valid LU ID when ordering if you intend to use the listed discount.
cards.short_summary: A café destination with a current Lawrence-listed discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Brewed Awakenings at 107 E. College Avenue with a 10% discount on everything.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer is for Lawrence students, faculty, and staff with valid ID.

cards.title: Crazy Sweet
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 514 W. College Avenue
cards.notes: Plan a candy stop on College Avenue; confirm eligible items and present valid LU ID before purchasing under the listed discount.
cards.short_summary: A candy shop with a documented discount on selected bulk and case items.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Crazy Sweet at 514 W. College Avenue with 10% off its chocolate case, bulk candy, and bulk taffy, subject to exclusions.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer excludes M&Ms and Jelly Belly machines; valid ID is required.

cards.title: Eco Candle Co.
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 123 E. College Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this College Avenue storefront to browse candles, then show a valid LU ID if making a purchase under the listed student offer.
cards.short_summary: A candle-shop stop with a current Lawrence ID discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Eco Candle Co. at 123 E. College Avenue and a 15% discount for students and staff with ID.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer requires a Lawrence student or staff ID.

cards.title: Fox Cities Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 400 W. College Avenue
cards.notes: Check the venue’s program before heading along College Avenue, and bring a valid student ID when pursuing a listed student rush ticket.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts venue with documented student rush-ticket availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists the Fox Cities Performing Arts Center at 400 W. College Avenue and says student rush tickets are posted online and available at its ticket office with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on posted student rush tickets; a valid student ID is required.

cards.title: Heid Music Co.
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 308 E. College Avenue
cards.notes: Use this College Avenue music-store stop to browse instruments or supplies and ask about the listed Lawrence ID discount before purchase.
cards.short_summary: A music retail destination with a published Lawrence discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Heid Music Co. at 308 E. College Avenue with 10% off in-stock merchandise and paid-in-full special orders, up to $150 total.
cards.access_notes: The listed discount has a $150 total limit and conditions for special orders.

cards.title: Legendairy Cookies ‘N Creamery
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 101 E. College Avenue
cards.notes: Choose this east College Avenue stop for ice cream and show a valid LU ID at purchase if using the documented student discount.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream stop with a Lawrence-listed percentage discount.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists Legendairy Cookies ‘N Creamery at 101 E. College Avenue with 10% off ice cream.
cards.access_notes: The listed offer is for Lawrence students, faculty, and staff with valid ID.

cards.title: Trout Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 111 W. College Avenue
cards.notes: Head to this College Avenue museum and ask about the Lawrence student membership option; verify current exhibition access before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A downtown art museum with a listed annual membership option for LU students.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists the Trout Museum of Art at 111 W. College Avenue and a $10 yearly membership for Lawrence students.
cards.access_notes: The listed membership offer is for Lawrence students; confirm museum entry terms directly.
